subject: english
title: Unit 9 Grammar 2 — Definitions with which
subtitle: v2 · The Lab Dictionary is scrambled — rebuild it by powering 6 stations: Word Lab, Which Spotlight, Fusion Chamber, Who/Which Gate, The Dictionary, and the Board Game. 36 slides.

content: Write and say a definition of a thing using the frame noun + which + verb phrase.
Fuse two short sentences into one definition, and spot the echo trap where the repeated subject must be dropped.
Choose between who and which by asking whether the noun is a person or a thing, connecting Unit 8's who clauses to Unit 9's which clauses.
language: Produce definitions with which for force and motion nouns: gravity, friction, skates, a bicycle, tetherball.
Use that as a substitute for which where it is allowed, and recognise where it is not.
Learn and use the new academic and content words: definitions, instructions, tetherball.
